import pytest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

from werkzeug.routing import Map, Rule, MapAdapter
from werkzeug.routing.exceptions import (
    BuildError,
    NoMatch,
    RequestAliasRedirect,
    RequestPath,
    RequestRedirect,
    WebsocketMismatch,
)
from werkzeug.exceptions import HTTPException, MethodNotAllowed, NotFound
from werkzeug.datastructures import MultiDict


class TestMap:
    """Tests for the Map class."""

    def test_map_initialization(self):
        """Test basic Map initialization."""
        m = Map()
        assert m.default_subdomain == ""
        assert m.strict_slashes is True
        assert m.merge_slashes is True
        assert m.redirect_defaults is True
        assert m.host_matching is False
        assert m.sort_parameters is False

    def test_map_with_rules(self):
        """Test Map initialization with rules."""
        rules = [Rule("/", endpoint="index"), Rule("/about", endpoint="about")]
        m = Map(rules)
        assert len(list(m.iter_rules())) == 2

    def test_map_add_rule(self):
        """Test adding rules to Map."""
        m = Map()
        m.add(Rule("/", endpoint="index"))
        m.add(Rule("/about", endpoint="about"))
        assert len(list(m.iter_rules())) == 2

    def test_map_is_endpoint_expecting(self):
        """Test is_endpoint_expecting method."""
        m = Map([
            Rule("/user/<int:id>", endpoint="user"),
            Rule("/user", endpoint="user_list")
        ])
        assert m.is_endpoint_expecting("user", "id") is True
        assert m.is_endpoint_expecting("user", "name") is False
        assert m.is_endpoint_expecting("user_list", "id") is False

    def test_map_iter_rules(self):
        """Test iter_rules method."""
        m = Map([
            Rule("/", endpoint="index"),
            Rule("/about", endpoint="about"),
            Rule("/contact", endpoint="contact")
        ])
        
        # All rules
        rules = list(m.iter_rules())
        assert len(rules) == 3
        
        # Specific endpoint
        about_rules = list(m.iter_rules(endpoint="about"))
        assert len(about_rules) == 1
        assert about_rules[0].endpoint == "about"

    def test_map_bind(self):
        """Test bind method."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        assert isinstance(adapter, MapAdapter)
        assert adapter.server_name == "example.com"
        assert adapter.script_name == "/"

    def test_map_bind_with_subdomain(self):
        """Test bind method with subdomain."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/", subdomain="www")
        assert adapter.subdomain == "www"

    def test_map_bind_to_environ(self):
        """Test bind_to_environ method."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        environ = {
            "SERVER_NAME": "example.com",
            "SERVER_PORT": "80",
            "wsgi.url_scheme": "http",
            "REQUEST_METHOD": "GET",
            "PATH_INFO": "/",
            "SCRIPT_NAME": "",
            "QUERY_STRING": "",
        }
        adapter = m.bind_to_environ(environ)
        assert adapter.server_name == "example.com"
        assert adapter.path_info == "/"

    def test_map_update(self):
        """Test update method."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        m.update()
        # Should not raise any exception
        assert m._remap is False

    def test_map_repr(self):
        """Test __repr__ method."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        repr_str = repr(m)
        assert "Map" in repr_str
        assert "index" in repr_str

    def test_map_strict_slashes(self):
        """Test strict_slashes behavior."""
        m = Map([Rule("/test", endpoint="test", strict_slashes=True)])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        
        # Without trailing slash should redirect
        with pytest.raises(RequestRedirect):
            adapter.match("/test")
        
        # With trailing slash should match
        result = adapter.match("/test/")
        assert result[0] == "test"

    def test_map_merge_slashes(self):
        """Test merge_slashes behavior."""
        m = Map([Rule("/test//path", endpoint="test", merge_slashes=True)])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        
        # Multiple slashes should be merged
        result = adapter.match("/test/path")
        assert result[0] == "test"


class TestMapAdapter:
    """Tests for the MapAdapter class."""

    def setup_method(self):
        """Set up test fixtures."""
        self.rules = [
            Rule("/", endpoint="index"),
            Rule("/about", endpoint="about"),
            Rule("/user/<int:id>", endpoint="user"),
            Rule("/user/<string:name>", endpoint="user_by_name"),
        ]
        self.m = Map(self.rules)
        self.adapter = self.m.bind("example.com", "/")

    def test_match_success(self):
        """Test successful URL matching."""
        result = self.adapter.match("/")
        assert result == ("index", {})

    def test_match_with_variable(self):
        """Test matching with variable parts."""
        result = self.adapter.match("/user/42")
        assert result == ("user", {"id": 42})

    def test_match_with_string_variable(self):
        """Test matching with string variables."""
        result = self.adapter.match("/user/john")
        assert result == ("user_by_name", {"name": "john"})

    def test_match_not_found(self):
        """Test matching when no rule matches."""
        with pytest.raises(NotFound):
            self.adapter.match("/nonexistent")

    def test_match_method_not_allowed(self):
        """Test matching when method doesn't match."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index", methods=["POST"])])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        
        with pytest.raises(MethodNotAllowed):
            adapter.match("/", method="GET")

    def test_match_return_rule(self):
        """Test match with return_rule=True."""
        result = self.adapter.match("/", return_rule=True)
        assert isinstance(result[0], Rule)
        assert result[1] == {}

    def test_match_with_query_args(self):
        """Test matching with query arguments."""
        result = self.adapter.match("/?q=test")
        assert result[0] == "index"

    def test_match_websocket_mismatch(self):
        """Test websocket mismatch detection."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index", websocket=True)])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/", url_scheme="http")
        
        with pytest.raises(WebsocketMismatch):
            adapter.match("/")

    def test_test_method(self):
        """Test test method."""
        assert self.adapter.test("/") is True
        assert self.adapter.test("/nonexistent") is False

    def test_allowed_methods(self):
        """Test allowed_methods method."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index", methods=["GET", "POST"])])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        
        methods = list(adapter.allowed_methods("/"))
        assert set(methods) == {"GET", "POST"}

    def test_get_host(self):
        """Test get_host method."""
        assert self.adapter.get_host(None) == "example.com"
        
        m = Map([], default_subdomain="www")
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        assert adapter.get_host("api") == "api.example.com"

    def test_make_redirect_url(self):
        """Test make_redirect_url method."""
        url = self.adapter.make_redirect_url("/new-path")
        assert "example.com" in url
        assert "/new-path" in url

    def test_build_basic(self):
        """Test basic URL building."""
        url = self.adapter.build("index", {})
        assert url == "/"

    def test_build_with_variable(self):
        """Test building URL with variable."""
        url = self.adapter.build("user", {"id": 42})
        assert url == "/user/42"

    def test_build_with_string_variable(self):
        """Test building URL with string variable."""
        url = self.adapter.build("user_by_name", {"name": "john"})
        assert url == "/user/john"

    def test_build_external(self):
        """Test building external URL."""
        url = self.adapter.build("index", {}, force_external=True)
        assert "http://example.com/" in url

    def test_build_with_query_params(self):
        """Test building URL with query parameters."""
        url = self.adapter.build("index", {"q": "test"})
        assert "?q=test" in url

    def test_build_with_multi_dict(self):
        """Test building URL with MultiDict."""
        md = MultiDict([("q", "a"), ("q", "b")])
        url = self.adapter.build("index", md)
        assert "?q=a&q=b" in url

    def test_build_not_found(self):
        """Test building non-existent endpoint."""
        with pytest.raises(BuildError):
            self.adapter.build("nonexistent", {})

    def test_build_with_method(self):
        """Test building URL with specific method."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index", methods=["GET", "POST"])])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        
        url = adapter.build("index", {}, method="GET")
        assert url == "/"

    def test_build_websocket(self):
        """Test building WebSocket URL."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index", websocket=True)])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/", url_scheme="ws")
        
        url = adapter.build("index", {})
        assert url.startswith("ws://")

    def test_dispatch(self):
        """Test dispatch method."""
        def view_func(endpoint, values):
            return f"{endpoint}:{values}"
        
        result = self.adapter.dispatch(view_func)
        assert result == "index:{}"

    def test_dispatch_catch_http_exceptions(self):
        """Test dispatch with catch_http_exceptions."""
        def view_func(endpoint, values):
            raise NotFound()
        
        result = self.adapter.dispatch(view_func, catch_http_exceptions=True)
        assert isinstance(result, HTTPException)

    def test_build_force_external_different_domain(self):
        """Test building external URL for different domain."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        
        # Different subdomain should force external
        adapter2 = m.bind("other.com", "/")
        url = adapter2.build("index", {})
        assert "other.com" in url

    def test_build_append_unknown_false(self):
        """Test building URL without unknown parameters."""
        url = self.adapter.build("index", {"unknown": "value"}, append_unknown=False)
        assert "?" not in url

    def test_partial_build(self):
        """Test _partial_build helper method."""
        rv = self.adapter._partial_build("index", {}, None, True)
        assert rv is not None
        assert len(rv) == 3

    def test_bind_to_environ_with_subdomain_calculation(self):
        """Test bind_to_environ calculates subdomain correctly."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        environ = {
            "SERVER_NAME": "staging.dev.example.com",
            "SERVER_PORT": "80",
            "wsgi.url_scheme": "http",
            "REQUEST_METHOD": "GET",
            "PATH_INFO": "/",
            "SCRIPT_NAME": "",
            "QUERY_STRING": "",
        }
        adapter = m.bind_to_environ(environ, server_name="example.com")
        assert adapter.subdomain == "staging.dev"

    def test_bind_to_environ_invalid_server_name(self):
        """Test bind_to_environ with invalid server name."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index")])
        environ = {
            "SERVER_NAME": "invalid-server-name-with-special-chars-!@#$%",
            "SERVER_PORT": "80",
            "wsgi.url_scheme": "http",
            "REQUEST_METHOD": "GET",
            "PATH_INFO": "/",
            "SCRIPT_NAME": "",
            "QUERY_STRING": "",
        }
        
        with pytest.warns(UserWarning):
            adapter = m.bind_to_environ(environ, server_name="example.com")
            assert adapter.subdomain == "<invalid>"

    def test_bind_to_environ_websocket_upgrade(self):
        """Test bind_to_environ detects WebSocket upgrade."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index", websocket=True)])
        environ = {
            "SERVER_NAME": "example.com",
            "SERVER_PORT": "443",
            "wsgi.url_scheme": "https",
            "HTTP_CONNECTION": "upgrade",
            "HTTP_UPGRADE": "websocket",
            "REQUEST_METHOD": "GET",
            "PATH_INFO": "/",
            "SCRIPT_NAME": "",
            "QUERY_STRING": "",
        }
        adapter = m.bind_to_environ(environ)
        assert adapter.websocket is True

    def test_map_host_matching(self):
        """Test host matching mode."""
        m = Map([Rule("/", endpoint="index", host="example.com")], host_matching=True)
        adapter = m.bind("example.com", "/")
        
        result = adapter.match("/")
        assert result[0] == "index"

    def test_map_host_matching_with_subdomain_error(self):
        """Test host matching raises error with subdomain."""
        m = Map(host_matching=True)

class TestDechunkedInput(unittest.TestCase):
    """Tests for the DechunkedInput class."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.rfile = io.BytesIO()

    def test_readable(self):
        input_stream = DechunkedInput(self.rfile)
        self.assertTrue(input_stream.readable())

    def test_read_chunk_len_valid(self):
        self.rfile.write(b"10\r\n")
        self.rfile.seek(0)
        input_stream = DechunkedInput(self.rfile)
        length = input_stream.read_chunk_len()
        self.assertEqual(length, 16)

    def test_read_chunk_len_invalid(self):
        self.rfile.write(b"invalid\r\n")
        self.rfile.seek(0)
        input_stream = DechunkedInput(self.rfile)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            input_stream.read_chunk_len()

    def test_read_chunk_len_negative(self):
        self.rfile.write(b"-1\r\n")
        self.rfile.seek(0)
        input_stream = DechunkedInput(self.rfile)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            input_stream.read_chunk_len()

    def test_readinto_with_data(self):
        self.rfile.write(b"5\r\ndata\r\n")
        self.rfile.seek(0)
        input_stream = DechunkedInput(self.rfile)
        buf = bytearray(10)
        result = input_stream.readinto(buf)
        self.assertEqual(result, 4)
        self.assertEqual(bytes(buf[:4]), b"data")

    def test_readinto_final_chunk(self):
        self.rfile.write(b"5\r\ndata\r\n0\r\n")
        self.rfile.seek(0)
        input_stream = DechunkedInput(self.rfile)
        buf = bytearray(10)
        result = input_stream.readinto(buf)
        self.assertEqual(result, 4)
        self.assertEqual(bytes(buf[:4]), b"data")

    def test_readinto_missing_terminator(self):
        self.rfile.write(b"5\r\ndata")
        self.rfile.seek(0)
        input_stream = DechunkedInput(self.rfile)
        buf = bytearray(10)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError):
            input_stream.readinto(buf)


class TestWSGIRequestHandler(unittest.TestCase):
    """Tests for the WSGIRequestHandler class."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.handler = WSGIRequestHandler
        self.mock_server = Mock()
        self.mock_server.ssl_context = None
        self.mock_server.multithread = False
        self.mock_server.multiprocess = False
        self.mock_server.server_address = ("localhost", 8000)
        self.mock_server._server_version = "Werkzeug/2.0.0"
        self.mock_connection = Mock()
        self.mock_rfile = io.BytesIO()
        self.mock_wfile = io.BytesIO()

    def test_make_environ_basic(self):
        handler = self.handler(None, self.mock_rfile, self.mock_wfile)
        handler.server = self.mock_server
        handler.client_address = ("127.0.0.1", 12345)
        handler.command = "GET"
        handler.path = "/test/path?query=value"
        handler.request_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        handler.headers = {"Host": "example.com"}
        
        environ = handler.make_environ()
        
        self.assertEqual(environ["REQUEST_METHOD"], "GET")
        self.assertEqual(environ["PATH_INFO"], "/test/path")
        self.assertEqual(environ["QUERY_STRING"], "query=value")
        self.assertEqual(environ["SERVER_NAME"], "localhost")
        self.assertEqual(environ["SERVER_PORT"], "8000")
        self.assertEqual(environ["REMOTE_ADDR"], "127.0.0.1")
        self.assertEqual(environ["REMOTE_PORT"], 12345)

    def test_make_environ_https(self):
        handler = self.handler(None, self.mock_rfile, self.mock_wfile)
        mock_ssl_server = Mock()
        mock_ssl_server.ssl_context = Mock()
        mock_ssl_server.multithread = False
        mock_ssl_server.multiprocess = False
        mock_ssl_server.server_address = ("localhost", 8000)
        mock_ssl_server._server_version = "Werkzeug/2.0.0"
        handler.server = mock_ssl_server
        
        environ = handler.make_environ()
        self.assertEqual(environ["wsgi.url_scheme"], "https")

    def test_make_environ_headers(self):
        handler = self.handler(None, self.mock_rfile, self.mock_wfile)
        handler.server = self.mock_server
        handler.client_address = ("127.0.0.1", 12345)
        handler.command = "POST"
        handler.path = "/test"
        handler.request_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        handler.headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Content-Length": "100",
            "X-Custom-Header": "custom-value",
        }
        
        environ = handler.make_environ()
        self.assertEqual(environ["CONTENT_TYPE"], "application/json")
        self.assertEqual(environ["CONTENT_LENGTH"], "100")
        self.assertEqual(environ["HTTP_X_CUSTOM_HEADER"], "custom-value")

    def test_make_environ_chunked_encoding(self):
        handler = self.handler(None, self.mock_rfile, self.mock_wfile)
        handler.server = self.mock_server
        handler.client_address = ("127.0.0.1", 12345)
        handler.command = "POST"
        handler.path = "/test"
        handler.request_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        handler.headers = {"Transfer-Encoding": "chunked"}
        
        environ = handler.make_environ()
        self.assertIn("wsgi.input_terminated", environ)

    def test_address_string(self):
        handler = self.handler(None, self.mock_rfile, self.mock_wfile)
        handler.server = self.mock_server
        handler.client_address = ("192.168.1.1", 8080)
        
        # Without environ
        addr = handler.address_string()
        self.assertEqual(addr, "192.168.1.1")
        
        # With environ
        handler.environ = {"REMOTE_ADDR": "10.0.0.1"}
        addr = handler.address_string()
        self.assertEqual(addr, "10.0.0.1")

    def test_port_integer(self):
        handler = self.handler(None, self.mock_rfile, self.mock_wfile)
        handler.server = self.mock_server
        handler.client_address = ("192.168.1.1", 8080)
        
        port = handler.port_integer()
        self.assertEqual(port, 8080)

    def test_do_method_forwarding(self):
        handler = self.handler(None, self.mock_rfile, self.mock_wfile)
        handler.server = self.mock_server
        
        # All do_* methods should be forwarded to run_wsgi
        self.assertEqual(handler.do_GET, handler.run_wsgi)
        self.assertEqual(handler.do_POST, handler.run_wsgi)
        self.assertEqual(handler.do_PUT, handler.run_wsgi)

import copy
import pytest
from werkzeug.datastructures import structures

class TestImmutableList:
    def test_basic_operations(self):
        il = structures.ImmutableList([1, 2, 3])
        assert len(il) == 3
        assert il[0] == 1
        assert il[-1] == 3
        assert il[1] == 2

    def test_immutable_raises_error(self):
        il = structures.ImmutableList([1, 2, 3])
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            il.append(4)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            il[0] = 10
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            il.extend([4, 5])

    def test_repr(self):
        il = structures.ImmutableList([1, 2, 3])
        assert "ImmutableList" in repr(il)


class TestTypeConversionDict:
    def test_get_with_type_conversion(self):
        d = structures.TypeConversionDict(foo='42', bar='blub')
        assert d.get('foo', type=int) == 42
        assert d.get('bar', -1, type=int) == -1

    def test_get_without_type(self):
        d = structures.TypeConversionDict(foo='42')
        assert d.get('foo') == '42'

    def test_get_missing_key(self):
        d = structures.TypeConversionDict()
        assert d.get('missing') is None
        assert d.get('missing', default=10) == 10

    def test_get_with_invalid_type(self):
        d = structures.TypeConversionDict(foo='not_a_number')
        assert d.get('foo', default=-1, type=int) == -1


class TestImmutableTypeConversionDict:
    def test_copy_returns_mutable(self):
        d = structures.ImmutableTypeConversionDict({'a': '1'})
        copy_d = d.copy()
        assert isinstance(copy_d, structures.TypeConversionDict)
        assert not isinstance(copy_d, structures.ImmutableTypeConversionDict)

    def test_copy_is_noop(self):
        d = structures.ImmutableTypeConversionDict({'a': '1'})
        copied = copy.copy(d)
        assert copied is d

    def test_get_with_type(self):
        d = structures.ImmutableTypeConversionDict({'a': '42'})
        assert d.get('a', type=int) == 42

        d = {'x': [1, 2], 'y': 3}
        md = structures.MultiDict(d)
        assert md['x'] == 1

class TestResponseInit:

        resp = Response("Hello World")

        resp = Response(b"Hello World")

        resp = Response(headers={"X-Custom": "value"})

        assert resp.content_type == "application/json; charset=utf-8"

        resp = Response(response=b"data", direct_passthrough=True)
        assert resp.direct_passthrough is True

class TestURL:
    def test_url_from_string(self):
        url = URL("http://example.com/path?query=value")
        assert str(url) == "http://example.com/path?query=value"
        assert url.scheme == "http"
        assert url.netloc == "example.com"
        assert url.path == "/path"
        assert url.query == "query=value"
        assert url.fragment == ""

    def test_url_from_scope(self):
        scope = {
            "type": "http",
            "scheme": "https",
            "server": ("example.com", 443),
            "path": "/api/test",
            "headers": [(b"host", b"example.com")],
            "query_string": b"foo=bar",
        }
        url = URL(scope=scope)
        assert url.scheme == "https"
        assert url.path == "/api/test"
        assert url.query == "foo=bar"

    def test_url_from_scope_with_host_header(self):
        scope = {
            "type": "http",
            "scheme": "http",
            "server": None,
            "path": "/test",
            "headers": [(b"host", b"example.com:8080")],
            "query_string": b"",
        }
        url = URL(scope=scope)
        assert url.scheme == "http"
        assert url.hostname == "example.com"
        assert url.port == 8080

    def test_url_from_components(self):
        url = URL(scheme="https", netloc="example.com", path="/path")
        assert url.scheme == "https"
        assert url.netloc == "example.com"
        assert url.path == "/path"

    def test_url_properties(self):
        url = URL("http://user:pass@example.com:8080/path?query=value#fragment")
        assert url.username == "user"
        assert url.password == "pass"
        assert url.hostname == "example.com"
        assert url.port == 8080
        assert url.is_secure is False

    def test_url_is_secure(self):
        https_url = URL("https://example.com")
        wss_url = URL("wss://example.com")
        http_url = URL("http://example.com")
        ws_url = URL("ws://example.com")
        assert https_url.is_secure is True
        assert wss_url.is_secure is True
        assert http_url.is_secure is False
        assert ws_url.is_secure is False

    def test_url_replace(self):
        url = URL("http://example.com/path")
        new_url = url.replace(path="/newpath")
        assert str(new_url) == "http://example.com/newpath"

    def test_url_replace_with_hostname_port(self):
        url = URL("http://example.com:8080/path")
        new_url = url.replace(hostname="new.com", port=9090)
        assert new_url.hostname == "new.com"
        assert new_url.port == 9090

    def test_url_replace_with_username_password(self):
        url = URL("http://example.com/path")
        new_url = url.replace(username="user", password="pass")
        assert new_url.username == "user"
        assert new_url.password == "pass"

    def test_url_include_query_params(self):
        url = URL("http://example.com/path?a=1")
        new_url = url.include_query_params(b=2, c=3)
        assert "a=1" in str(new_url)
        assert "b=2" in str(new_url)
        assert "c=3" in str(new_url)

    def test_url_replace_query_params(self):
        url = URL("http://example.com/path?a=1&b=2")
        new_url = url.replace_query_params(c=3, d=4)
        assert "c=3" in str(new_url)
        assert "d=4" in str(new_url)
        assert "a=1" not in str(new_url)
        assert "b=2" not in str(new_url)

    def test_url_remove_query_params(self):
        url = URL("http://example.com/path?a=1&b=2&c=3")
        new_url = url.remove_query_params(["a", "c"])
        assert "a=1" not in str(new_url)
        assert "c=3" not in str(new_url)
        assert "b=2" in str(new_url)

    def test_url_equality(self):
        url1 = URL("http://example.com/path")
        url2 = URL("http://example.com/path")
        url3 = URL("http://example.com/other")
        assert url1 == url2
        assert url1 != url3

    def test_url_repr_with_password(self):
        url = URL("http://user:password@example.com/path")
        repr_str = repr(url)
        assert "********" in repr_str

    def test_url_invalid_scope_and_url(self):
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            URL(url="http://example.com", scope={})

    def test_url_invalid_scope_and_components(self):
        with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
            URL(scope={}, scheme="http")

async def simple_app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send):

async def echo_websocket(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send):
    websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive, send)
    await websocket.accept()
    while True:
        data = await websocket.receive_text()
        await websocket.send_text(f"Echo: {data}")
    await websocket.close()


async def lifespan_app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send):
    if scope["type"] == "lifespan":
        while True:
            message = await receive()
            if message["type"] == "lifespan.startup":
                await send({"type": "lifespan.startup.complete"})
            elif message["type"] == "lifespan.shutdown":
                await send({"type": "lifespan.shutdown.complete"})
                return
